description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ganegoda, Elpitiya D/S Division, Galle District - Cad. Map No. 810734 (23/0610)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extent measurements, owner names, identity card numbers, addresses, title classifications, and any encumbrances or mortgages. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land ownership and property registration matters, fitting squarely within the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
